reason: A project-agnostic skill for coordinating multi-agent work through role definitions, loop guards, structured handoffs, review routing, and a fixed delivery workflow.

summaries.zh: 为多智能体团队提供角色分工、循环防护、结构化交接、风险分流和交付评审流程的协作工作流技能。
summaries.en: A project-agnostic skill that coordinates multi-agent teams with role definitions, loop guards, structured handoffs, risk-based review routing, and delivery workflows.

capabilities: Defines multi-agent roles and collaboration rules
Provides loop-guard conditions for limiting repeated or stalled agent work
Structures handoffs and risk-tiered review routing
Specifies a verification, delivery, review, and closure workflow
